name: North Vernon (United States)
description: White field charged at the centre with the city logo: a blue disc with a yellow sun and rays, a red caboose, green grass and the black silhouettes of a man, woman and child.
history: North Vernon is a city in Jennings County, Indiana. The flag was adopted on 9 September 2021 (the logo won a city contest in 1988 but was never put on a flag until the drawing was rediscovered in 2020; the flag was first flown on 9 September 2021, according to Flags of the World citing the Madison Courier).

features.role: silhouettes of a man, woman and child
